review: The new method fixes physical gate m=6 and H=2048 and preserves the saved beta_exact integer boundary at every D from 0 through 512. Only the late threshold at D>=513 is calibrated.

The concatenated table remains a deterministic symmetric sign-tail table, so the previously proved conservative physical-gate null and strict-sign bounds apply without requiring a single global evidence threshold.

The no-late-stop table is exactly checked for feasibility. Nested late contours and monotone risk bounds justify upper-bracket expansion and binary search; the selected late threshold and the next lower grid point are both certified.

An independent verifier reconstructed the full early, late and next-lower late contours with binomial-coefficient inequalities and re-spliced them without importing production code. It recomputed all ordinary and homogeneous-prefix survivor counts from d=0.

The late threshold 281.716172 gives null upper bound 0.009999982346466218 and strict wrong-sign upper bound 0.009829722860308313. The immediately lower grid point has null upper bound 0.010000000714990596 and fails.

Runtime objects must be verified, budgets are enforced, and the fixed first-six prefix must be captured from actual chronology. The replay rejects an aggregate block that straddles this prefix and never invents an earlier physical checkpoint.

The wrapper binds audited original inputs and sources, the passed independent boundary audit, and both summary dependencies at start and end. All 576 development paths are included; any unobserved continuation would remain right-censored.

The full replay was independently reconstructed without importing the gate or replay producers. Every checkpoint certificate and first stopping prefix matched. All combined costs and outcomes matched, with zero censoring.

Against beta_exact on these 576 paths: 58 use fewer shots, 518 use the same number, zero use more, and there are zero decision changes or lost correct decisions. This is an observed development result.
limits: The D512 switch and gate were selected during development. The replay is not held-out validation and supplies no inferential confidence interval.
No observed pathwise regression does not establish uniform dominance: on other paths where beta_exact crosses after D512, the higher late threshold can delay or prevent its decision before cap.
The main-case correct-stop rate remains below the 95% acceptance target; geometric cost improvement alone does not meet that target.
The finite-budget, independent-pair and common-ordering assumptions remain essential. The method is one fixed gate/table pair, not a union over explored candidates.
No novelty, hardware performance or SOTA acceptance claim follows from this review.
